notablePrerequisites: You control at least two creatures with defender.
description:
Activate Overgrown Battlement by tapping it, adding at least {G}{G}.
Activate Aphetto Alchemist by tapping it, targeting Overgrown Battlement.
Battlemage's Bracers triggers, causing you to pay {1} to copy Aphetto Alchemist's ability, targeting Aphetto Alchemist.
Resolve both Aphetto Alchemist abilities, untapping it and Overgrown Battlement.
Repeat.
